Kuopio, Finland · academy@kups.ﬁ · +358 40 123 4567 · www.kups.ﬁ

Dear Dennis Wafula,
INVITATION TO A TRIAL PERIOD
Following the video footage provided by your coach and our scouting report from the FKF Premier
League, we would like to invite you for a trial with our ﬁrst team squad.
The trial period runs from 19 January 2027 to 26 January 2027. Please plan to arrive in Kuopio on 18
January 2027 and depart on 27 January 2027.
During the trial the club will provide accommodation and meals. Travel costs to Finland, travel insurance
and your Schengen visa application are your own responsibility. On request we will send a formal
invitation letter to support your visa application at the Embassy of Finland in Nairobi.
KuPS does not charge any fee for trials, and no agent or third party is authorised to collect money on
behalf of the club. If anyone asks you for payment in connection with this invitation, please contact us
directly at the address above.
Please conﬁrm your attendance by 20 November 2026.
Kind regards,
Mikko Laitinen
Academy and Recruitment Coordinator
